title: Concept: Yii debugger toolbar disclosed
description: The Yii debugger keeps a per-request history that includes the SQL, the session and the configuration. Its toolbar in a response also means the history route is registered, and that route lists other users requests by id.
applicability: Responses from a Yii application deployed with the debug module enabled.
risk: The caller reads query text, application parameters and, through the history route, other users requests.
